snippet.title: Breath of Fire 6 (JP) Gameplay IOS / Android
snippet.description:
ブレス オブ ファイア 6 白竜の守護者たち by Capcom (IOS/Android)
Breath of Fire 6: Hakuryū no Shugosha-tachi (ブレスオブファイア6 白竜の守護者たち lit. Breath of Fire 6: Guardians of the White Dragon?) is an online, web-based role-playing video game developed and published by Capcom as the sixth main installment of its Breath of Fire series. The game is set for release in Japan in February 2016, and is being created for touch-based Microsoft Windows computers, as well as iOS and Android devices


DOWNLOAD

App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/jp/app/buresu-obu-faia-6-bai-longno/id885330374
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.capcom.bof6.android
